forbid.reason: a push must prompt, since that prompt confirms anything leaving this clone, a deploy included
broad git branch pre-approves deleting branches and moving the trunk
broad git fetch pre-approves a forced or local fetch into the trunk
broad git merge pre-approves merge commits on the trunk
broad git rebase pre-approves rewriting the trunk
git reset moves the current branch and can discard uncommitted work
git update-ref moves or deletes any ref, the trunk included
